hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-[7vw] font-black uppercase tracking-tighter leading-[0.85]
hierarchy.h2: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold uppercase tracking-tight leading-none

typography.pairing_archetype: The Swiss Brutalist (Tech / Art) meets Organic Craft - High contrast weights (Black for headings, Light for body) with bold uppercase display and sterile readable body.
rules: No default sans like Inter or Roboto for headings.
Headlines MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Never center-align body text. Center-align headings only if intentional for symmetry.
Uppercase for all major section titles.
Use anthracite/charcoal as primary contrast on neutral background.
Accent colors (wood, sage, brass) are used sparingly for interaction highlights (hover, active, swatches).
No full-screen generic gradients. Rely on solid color blocking.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy - Use 2-3x more spacing than typical. p-8 to p-24.

grids.marketing: MODE A (Tetris Grid) for Home/Gallery. Asymmetry, wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12). Leave negative space.
grids.configurator: MODE B (High Density Grid) for the configurator dashboard. Tight gaps (gap-4). Every pixel utilized.
grids.masonry: Columns format for Gallery with staggered heights.

spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical Alignment > Geometric. Left-align paragraphs and dense content.

surfaces: No heavy shadows. Use subtle ambient shadow if needed (shadow-sm) combined with 1px border.
textures: Subtle noise overlay on the hero section to kill digital flatness.
images: Real product photography treated deliberately. Use clipped frames, spotlight effects.
Max overlay opacity bg-black/30 on images.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular buttons. Dark anthracite background, white text. On hover, background shifts to accent_wood or darkens. Arrow icon animates x: 5px.
components.cards: Cardless or minimal border cards. The 'Technical' look (Grid borders) for features/Why Choose Us.
components.swatches: Circular or rounded-sm squares for CNC panels. 1px border. Hover scales slightly. Active state has an offset ring.
components.configurator_panel: Fixed side panel (or sticky). Clean, tabular layout for live summary. Soft Neumorphism/Crisp edges (border-black/5).
components.marquee: The 'Editorial Ribbon' - very slow, smooth drift. Large uppercase outline text (text-8xl+) running in background, or subtle pale sage bg with dark text.
components.navigation: Sticky header with Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80) with 1px delicate inner stroke at bottom. Bilingual toggle prominent (MK / EN).

home_page.hero: Kinetic Hero with masked line-by-line reveal. Subtext fades in. Background has a 2.5D parallax or subtle scale effect on high-res furniture photo.
home_page.manifesto: Numbered manifesto chapters. Large typography. Asymmetric layout.
home_page.marquee: Slow editorial marquee dividing sections: 'CUSTOM MANUFACTURING — PREMIUM CRAFT'.
home_page.featured_products: Horizontal scroll carousel or bento grid with clipped frames.

configurator_page.layout: Two-column dense grid. Left: Step-by-step interactive forms (Material, Style, Finish, Dimensions). Right: Live Preview & Summary.
configurator_page.interactions: Smooth transitions between steps. Configurator inputs use customized Shadcn forms.

presets.kinetic_reveal: Masked text reveal: wrapper overflow-hidden, child animate y: '100%' -> '0%', duration 0.8s, stagger 0.1s.
presets.scroll_reveal: Elements fade in and translate y: 30px on viewport enter. Use framer-motion whileInView.
presets.parallax: Subtle y-axis transform tied to scroll position via useScroll and useTransform for hero images and floating elements.

rules: All interactive elements need micro-animations (hover states, scale 0.98 on click).

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion for 2.5D parallax and smooth transitions. Avoid full 3D canvas (R3F) unless specifically providing a 3D furniture viewer in the configurator, which is not strictly requested. Keep it high-end photography focused.

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute tool calls in parallel whenever possible.
Do not use generic placeholders like 'via.placeholder.com' or 'dummyimage.com'. Use the provided image URLs.
Create Shadcn components in '/app/frontend/src/components/ui/' and customize them according to the styling guidelines.
Ensure the bilingual toggle works effectively. Use i18next or a simple context switcher for MVP.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='nav-about-link', data-testid='configurator-next-btn').
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling in the main Layout/App component.
For the configurator, prioritize dense spacing and crisp borders over rounded cards.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use asymmetrical layouts, bold typography, and layered depth.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
DO NOT apply universal transitions like 'transition: all'. Apply to specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is forbidden).
Use pill-shaped or sharp buttons with micro-interactions.
NEVER use emojis for icons. Use 'lucide-react' or '@phosphor-icons/react'.
Every interaction needs micro-animations. Static is dead.
DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays with content underneath.
